# Tables beside and inside JSX

A table between two JSX blocks keeps its cells translatable while the elements
around it stay skeleton.

| Verb   | What it does                  |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| `up`   | Converges the project         |
| `push` | Sends the declared tree       |
